$meta.product: HADR COMMAND — Disaster Response Common Operating Picture
$meta.note: Source-of-truth design tokens for the React + Tailwind + shadcn/ui build. UI colors are CSS variables (Tailwind-compatible via hsl/hex). Map-layer colors are RGBA arrays that feed deck.gl v9 layers directly and are NOT CSS. Dark is the ops-room default; light is for bright briefing rooms. All text/status pairs meet WCAG AA on their actual surface.
$meta.classification: OFFICIAL (PSPF) — rendered top and bottom, centered, DM/IBM Plex Mono, letter-spaced, understated.

status.comment: Phase and operational status. Same names both themes; values tuned per theme for AA contrast.

phase.comment: Cyclone phase progression. Drives the top-bar phase chip and the scrubber phase bands.

damage-ramp.comment: Ordinal, colourblind-safe, legible on dark satellite. Same ramp for 3D building damage and hex density.

posture.comment: Rendered as a neutral chip with a coloured dot — not a full-colour pill.

rules.numerals: All timestamps, coordinates and KPI figures use the mono family with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.
rules.micro-labels: Uppercase section headers use mono, weight 600, letter-spacing 0.14–0.16em, color text-3.

elevation.comment: Panels use flat borders, no shadow. Floating click-cards and the SITREP drawer are the only elevated surfaces.

layout.degrade-1440: panels narrow, KPI grid reflows 3×2; scrubber and drawer keep fixed widths.

motion.comment: Subtle and purposeful. Ease-out cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1). No bounces/springs. Pulsing is reserved for LIVE mode and active warnings only (≤1Hz).

live-pulse.note: LIVE dot opacity 1→0.25; the only permitted ambient pulse besides active warnings

track-dash.note: cyclone track marching ants; optional, disable for glance-from-4m if distracting

map_layers_rgba.comment: deck.gl v9 over MapLibre. RGBA arrays [r,g,b,a], a in 0–255. Values assume a dark satellite/dark basemap (kept dark in BOTH UI themes). If a light basemap is ever enabled, darken fills ~15% and raise line opacity.

wind_field.comment: single-hue sequential violet, light→intense; deliberately off-ramp from the red damage colours

map_layers_rgba.damage_density_hex: same ramp as building_damage_3d; elevation encodes count, colour encodes worst class in cell
